title: PathIQ
description: AI-powered career intelligence platform that replaces anecdotal career advice with real-time labor market data and AI-driven analysis for undergraduates. Combines real-time labor market data (salary percentiles, job openings, growth trends) with AI-driven trade-off analysis to compare career paths, surface insights, and provide personalized recommendations through an interactive dashboard and natural-language career chat.

title: Photography Scene Finder
description: Composition-scoring ML models to evaluate image aesthetics and suggest improved angles. Built the backend pipeline for image ingestion, feature extraction, and real-time scoring. Improved recommendation accuracy by refining model architecture and optimizing training data workflows.

title: Loadstone
description: Mobile-first decision-support app for students, combining task planning, wellbeing signals, and AI tools. NestJS backend with Azure Cosmos DB, OIDC authentication via Entra External ID, and Azure OpenAI integration with schema-validated tool-calling.

title: ASL Alphabet Translator
description: Real-time ASL alphabet translator using CNN and Random Forest models achieving 95%+ accuracy. Built a video inference pipeline with MediaPipe and OpenCV, reducing latency by 40% using TFLite.

title: Algorithmic Trading Platform
description: Desktop trading platform with event-driven strategy execution for algorithmic trading. Integrated live market data via Fyers SDK and implemented moving average and volume-driven trading strategies with real-time execution capabilities.

title: HackDavis
description: Core technical platform powering UC Davis' largest student-run hackathon (1000+ participants). Designed and implemented judge-to-team pairing algorithms, event calendar infrastructure, and a RAG-based generative AI chatbot for participant support. Led backend automation for ticketing and communications, migrating away from Mailchimp/EmailJS to a custom Nodemailer-based system integrated with Tito, reducing per-email latency from 2.7s to 1.2s via parallelized workflows while lowering operational costs.

title: Collaborative Trip Planning Platform
description: Website to allow people to interactively plan trips together. Invite others using unique join codes, create activities, and allow users to vote for desirable activities.

title: Song Genre Classifier
description: Predict a song's genre purely from its audio file using a Random Forest Classifier.

title: Nilay Health
description: Full-stack patient management system for hospitals. Features include patient records, appointment and medication scheduling, automated prescription generation, and Twilio SMS reminders that reduced missed appointments by ~25% for 400+ patients weekly.

title: Donation and Inventory Manager
description: Website facilitating in-person item donations for Davis Community Meals and Housing. Highlights in-demand items to ensure balanced inventory, with admin controls for tracking levels and sending email notifications for high-need items.

title: On-Device Speech-to-Text Engine
description: React Native voice assistant for a stock advice app with local speech-to-text conversion. Integrated on-device speech recognition with pronunciation variants for 150+ companies.

title: Thrift Store Goods Tracker
description: Deployed TensorFlow models on a Raspberry Pi to classify clothing types and improve thrift store inventory tracking. Built a front-end system for managing inventory and accelerating the checkout process, streamlining thrift store operations by automating item classification.

title: Breast Cancer Classification Benchmarking
description: Comparing 10 different ML models to find the best one for classification of breast cancer.
